caseName: Etere v. City of New York
caseNameFull: Etere v. City of New York, New York Clifton v. Florida Parole Commission

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir.; and

C. A. 11th Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners are allowed until April 11, 2011, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
